title_en: Must and must not: moram, ne smeš
card_en: Morati, to have to, takes the infinitive: moram počivati. For must not, use ne smeš, ne sme: danes ne smeš delati. Ne moraš only means you do not have to.

2.sg.note_en: Ne moraš means you do not have to; ne smeš means you must not.

2.pl.note_en: Also the polite you: morate počivati.

you must.en: You have to rest. (to someone close)

you do not have to.en: You don't have to work. (to someone close)

quick_check.explain_en: Bolan si speaks to someone close, so morati takes the ti form moraš; morem means I can.

helper_de: moram is like ich muss, with a plain infinitive. Ne smeš is du darfst nicht; ne moraš is du musst nicht.
helper_en: English must not forbids; ne moraš does not. To forbid, use ne smeš.
